string.text: Barter for the passcode to unlock the lab

The bandits’ leader in the Dark Valley has agreed to exchange the passcode to unlock the lab for either: an AS “Val” rifle and five bottles of vodka, or five jars of Jelly. He also asked me to send his regards to Snitch at the Bar.
Find either an AS “Val” rifle and five bottles of vodka, or five jars of Jelly
